text.tspan: 10 · Decision: Kea HA on-prem (A); DHCP stays out of AWS
from the VPC, not from Kea.
Kea in AWS could only serve
DHCP option 6 hands out both anycast resolver IPs: .53 and .54 (07).
Not chosen: C Kea on EC2 only (fails the provider-failure rule) · D Windows Server DHCP · E commercial DDI
